descriptions.en: Places: World TSP (University of Waterloo; National Imagery and Mapping Agency and USGS GNIS names data). Borders: Made with Natural Earth (public domain). The 2,850 places of our Europe map in Switzerland, with the same coordinates: whole metres in a map projection; straight lines, not great-circle or road distances. Concorde proved the optimum on our laptop (QSopt) and on the NEOS Server (CPLEX), 17 Nov 2026.
descriptions.sl: Kraji: World TSP (University of Waterloo; podatki o imenih National Imagery and Mapping Agency in USGS GNIS). Meje: Made with Natural Earth (javna last). 2.850 krajev našega zemljevida Evrope v Švici, z istimi koordinatami: celi metri v projekciji zemljevida; ravne črte, ne razdalje po velikem krogu ali po cestah. Concorde je optimum dokazal na našem prenosniku (QSopt) in na strežniku NEOS (CPLEX), 17. nov. 2026.

descriptions.en: 23,761 real places of Croatia (settlements, parts of settlements, hamlets, villages and abandoned settlements) from the Croatian Register of Geographical Names; no place was moved, and about 800 lie on islands. Straight-line distances in whole metres in an equal-area projection, not roads.
descriptions.sl: 23.761 resničnih krajev Hrvaške (naselja, deli naselij, zaselki, vasi in zapuščena naselja) iz hrvaškega registra geografskih imen; noben kraj ni premaknjen, okoli 800 jih leži na otokih. Zračne razdalje v celih metrih v ploščinsko točni projekciji, ne ceste.

Zhong, Hard to solve instances of the Euclidean Traveling Salesman Problem, Mathematical Programming Computation 13 (2021) 51-74 (https://doi.org/10.1007/s12532-020-00184-5; data set CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.60507/FK2/ESZ1QZ); other number of points, scale and place; node order shuffled.

descriptions.en: A test map of 24,857 points: 11,325 real places of Croatia (settlements, villages and parts of settlements, no place moved; 46 % of the points) and 13,532 artificial points (54 %) in 68 small islands drawn in the Adriatic Sea, each island a triangle with a centre point and three spokes after a published layout by Hougardy and Zhong. Straight-line distances in whole metres in an equal-area projection, not roads. The map claims nothing about its shortest tour or about how other programs fare on it.
descriptions.sl: Preizkusni zemljevid z 24.857 točkami: 11.325 resničnih krajev Hrvaške (naselja, vasi in deli naselij, noben kraj ni premaknjen; 46 % točk) in 13.532 umetnih točk (54 %) v 68 majhnih otokih, narisanih v Jadranskem morju; vsak otok je trikotnik s središčno točko in tremi kraki po objavljeni razporeditvi Hougardyja in Zhonga. Zračne razdalje v celih metrih v ploščinsko točni projekciji, ne ceste. Zemljevid ne trdi ničesar o svoji najkrajši poti ali o tem, kako se na njem odrežejo drugi programi.
